spec: INV-02 and ADR-010 § Amendment. Modes are nearest, down and up; a value exactly halfway between two steps goes to the lighter load. The result is expected_steps × increment_kg, compared in the consumer's own arithmetic, so no float is written here.

cases.name: nearest rounds up past the midpoint
a tie goes to the lighter load
every tie goes to the lighter load
nearest rounds down below the midpoint
a load on the grid stays put under up
